property_summary: For any caller and any guess hash, locking in at block N records the guess block as N+1, so settle() succeeds at block N+2 (one block past the stored block); the mutant stores N+2 and settle() reverts at N+2, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Record block.number + 2 instead of block.number + 1 as the guess block.
